title: Representative normalization predicates for tensor shifts
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme W. On strict-system complexes define systemTotalTensor and systemKFlat, and the first-slot unsigned and second-slot (-1)^(ri) total-tensor generator formulas. For a natural shift comparison, systemTensorLeftProperty and systemTensorRightProperty assert that on every K-flat pair its component agrees, through the recorded tensor-model isomorphisms, with a cochain comparison satisfying the respective generator formula. On integral complexes, integralTensorLeftFormula is the unsigned first-slot formula at every finite quotient level. integralTensorLeftProperty requires this finite tower comparison on every good pair, its prescribed product/cone comparison with diagonal (1,(-1)^r), and agreement after the fixed [-1] Roos shift with the recorded completed tensor model. These are the unchanged predicates formerly declared in def-pur-integral-operation-shift-data; tensorShiftFirst shifts precisely the first argument of a bifunctor.
